Do not enlarge the quiz to consume the removed roadmap space. Do not move other sections, do not change fonts, do not generate new controls, do not add any numeric progress/score anywhere. No replacement completion banner. No count "3/8" or "2/8" anywhere on the screenshot. Keep word-token status checks as is. Keep output aspect ratio and visual identity. This is a surgical edit; all unchanged components identical to reference. Warm cream empty space where roadmap was is intentional. Return ONE flat polished desktop screenshot.
